landed_paths: tools/video-study/ (study.py CLI with 13 stages, viewer.html, fk_check.py, blender_proof.py, proofs.py, gen_learnings.py, run.sh, README.md, requirements.txt - 16 pins)
limitations: Face-parameter extraction is thin BY CONTENT, not by tooling: none of the six videos contains a sustained real face (screen recordings + distant subjects). The Face lab feed from V1/V6 is therefore limited to OCR of their on-screen parameter UI rather than tracked blendshapes.

V1/V3/V4 creator attributions in the repo catalog came from the task brief; on-screen watermarks OCR-read as @peanar3d (V1), @professoroakblenderlab (V3), @billsfilms1 (V4). Data files record what the tools measured.
Blender proof renders were produced twice but the PNG files did not survive this VM's filesystem instability; blender_proof.py + v5.bvh are in the repo to re-render deterministically.

This VM's filesystem served divergent snapshots to different processes all day (files intermittently 0-byte or stale across sessions; MEMORY.md was truncated by the same instability and recovered by the main agent). All landed state above was verified on GitHub via gh api, not from local reads.

The render PNGs themselves were casualties of the VM's filesystem instability; FK stick renders (in proofs) are the visual BVH validation: mean joint error 0.109 m, p95 0.253 m over 397 frames (fk_check.py; its own End-Site brace bug that fabricated 1.1 m leg errors was found and fixed en route). Blender 5.2.3 was not obtained.

dwpose_onnx.note: 513/513 frames, COCO-WholeBody 133 keypoints. Required a hand-written YOLOX raw-head grid decode (the yzd-v export is undecoded) + SimCC decode; visually sanity-verified (skeleton tracks the performer). First pass truncated at 243 frames on a decoder hiccup; retry got all 513.

easyocr.note: torch could not be installed on this VM (repeated pip failures + filesystem rollbacks). RapidOCR ran the ocr stage for all 6 videos; ocr.json names the engine that actually ran.

faster_whisper.note: Transcripts: v1/v2/v3/v5/v6 have segments, v4 = no_speech (honest). PyAV 19 removed av.open's metadata_errors kwarg that faster-whisper 1.2.1 passes - stage was patched to feed a numpy array decoded with the stdlib wave module.

ffmpeg_ffprobe.note: probe + audio/frame extraction for all stages
